name: Grade 9 IIIT Practice: September Week 2 - Sound Quality
description: Practice words for Grade 9 third-trimester STEM and cybersecurity work.

words.definition: How often sound is measured each second.
words.example: The team chose a higher sample rate so the recorded voice sounded clearer.

words.definition: How much detail each sound sample stores.
words.example: The larger sample size kept more detail in the sound file.
The microphone recorded the narration for the audio test.
The speaker played the edited clip so the group could check the volume.

words.definition: How clear or accurate sound is.
words.example: Background noise lowered the sound quality of the recording.

words.definition: Sound stored or played by a device.
words.example: The student exported the audio clip after trimming the silence.

words.definition: An option that changes how a file is saved.
words.example: The file setting changed the format before the student saved the recording.
